title: Filtering the sales table by numbers · part 41

steps.title: Filter then sort: total != 6632.85
steps.prompt:
Filter first, then ORDER BY tidies what is left.
LIMIT 3 keeps the top of that sorted list.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total != 6632.85 ORDER BY total LIMIT 3;
hints: Start with SELECT id FROM sales.
Add WHERE total != 6632.85.
Add ORDER BY total LIMIT 3.
Write: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total != 6632.85 ORDER BY total LIMIT 3;
steps.expected_sql: SELECT id FROM sales WHERE total != 6632.85 ORDER BY total LIMIT 3;
steps.memory_trick: WHERE trims, ORDER BY sorts, LIMIT cuts.
